justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear profile relief imagery on a flat stone face, with A showing a single schematic quadruped in profile and B including an animal head at its edge. Otherwise the depicted content differs entirely: B shows a procession of naturalistically modelled human figures in patterned robes carrying vessels, with a rosette border, while A shows one isolated, minimally outlined animal with no human figures, no border and no narrative relationship.
